name: fmcg-order-inventory-team
description: FMCG order and inventory team: demand range forecasting, inventory health checks, replenishment execution, and capital/policy risk review

displayDescription.en: Balances stockout and overstock through joint review: demand ranges, inventory health, executable order and transfer lists, plus cash and policy risk checks
displayDescription.zh: 通过联合评审平衡缺货与压货：需求区间、库存体检、可执行订货与调拨清单，以及资金与政策风险复核

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 下期订货会要定货了，帮我协同看一下需求、库存和资金，给出一份既不断货也不压货的订货方案。
defaultInitPrompt.en: The next order fair is coming; combine demand, inventory and cash into a plan that avoids both stockout and overstock.

quickPrompts.zh: 下期订货会要定货了，帮我协同看一下需求、库存和资金，给出一份既不断货也不压货的订货方案。
quickPrompts.en: Build a balanced order plan across demand, inventory and cash.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我判断哪些 SKU 要补、哪些要停，给出调拨方案
quickPrompts.en: Decide which SKUs to replenish or stop, with transfer options

quickPrompts.zh: 这次厂商政策力度很大，帮我评估接不接
quickPrompts.en: Assess whether to take this aggressive manufacturer policy
